name: ddos-legacy-plan
costSource: estimated (Network Protection plan list price, eastus, Retail Prices API)
reason: DDoS Network Protection plan protects no virtual networks or public IPs, but bills its fixed monthly fee
suggestedAction: Confirm with the owner (netops@example.com) that no virtual network is about to be linked, then delete the plan. Free DDoS infrastructure protection stays on. If only a few public IPs need DDoS protection, IP Protection per IP is usually cheaper.

name: fw-hub-legacy
idleSource: DataProcessed and rule hit metrics, 30 days
costSource: estimated (Premium deployment list price, eastus; capacity units and data processed extra, Retail Prices API)
reason: 0 application or network rule hits and 0 B processed in 30 days (Premium), but the deployment fee bills every hour
suggestedAction: Check route tables (forced tunneling, hub routing) and any planned spokes that send traffic through it. If it is not needed, delete it, or deallocate it to keep its configuration without the hourly fee (Azure PowerShell: $fw.Deallocate(); Set-AzFirewall $fw).

name: ippre-legacy
costSource: estimated (16 address(es) x prefix list price, eastus, Retail Prices API)

suggestedAction: Ask the owner (netops@example.com) whether these addresses are on a partner or firewall allowlist. Deleting the prefix releases them for good and you won't get the same range back. If nobody needs them, delete it.
